title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Details
content: CloudDash supports three built-in roles: Admin, Editor, and Viewer. 1. Viewer: Read-only access. Can view dashboards, metrics, and active alerts, but cannot edit them or access billing. 2. Editor: Viewer permissions plus ability to create/edit/delete dashboards, alert rules, and integrations. Cannot modify billing or manage users. 3. Admin: Full administrative privileges, including managing billing, user invites, API keys, and platform SSO configuration. Enterprise plans support custom role definitions with granular resource-level policies (e.g. read access limited to specific tagging scopes or environment namespaces). Users can be assigned multiple roles, and role changes are audited in our platform log streams.
